a.lede: Researchers remotely disabled a vulnerable updater in the abandoned Time4Popcorn app, a fork of the Popcorn Time BitTorrent client, closing a security flaw that could have allowed attackers to execute malicious code with elevated privileges on millions of computers. [...]
a.title: Abandoned Popcorn Time app exposed millions of devices to RCE attacks

b.lede: The Tailscale security team is working to patch almost a dozen security vulnerabilities that could be exploited to steal credentials, crash servers, gain root privileges, and more. [...]
b.title: Tailscale warns of SSH flaws allowing root privilege escalation
